messages:
Maya Chen: hey team — heads up: i'm planning to spend ~4 months in taiwan (mid-july → mid-nov). curious about a few things: will my WFH stipend be prorated? do i need to change my homebase/legal work location for payroll? any tax nexus concerns for redwood? also, can we ship my standing desk there?
Adrian Lopez: @Maya thanks for flagging this early — a few quick notes: 1) stipend: we prorate monthly allowances when an employee changes primary work location for payroll; short trips under 90 days typically don’t change homebase. 2) payroll/homebase: if you remain on US payroll and are just temporarily remote, we usually keep your homebase as is. 3) tax nexus: 4 months could trigger local regs depending on activities — need to confirm with tax. please fill the Remote Location Notification form so we can trigger payroll/tax/legal reviews.
Maya Chen: thanks — form submitted (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/forms/remote-notify). i’ll mark manager approval.
Priya Raman: confirmed — i approve the 4mo remote period. :thumbsup:
Payroll Bot: automated notice: Remote Location Notification received for Maya Chen. Ticket #RLOC-2024-183 created and assigned to Payroll & Tax.
Adrian Lopez: next steps: - payroll will confirm whether we must change homebase / tax withholding - tax/legal will advise on social security and local payroll obligations - ops will confirm equipment shipping options and customs docs.
Maya Chen: quick Q about stipend proration: if it's >90 days but <180, is that half-month or full months counted?
Adrian Lopez: good Q — we prorate by calendar month. For partial months at either end we pro-rate days. Example: leaving July 15 → July stipend = (17/31) * monthly amount.
Kyle (Legal): tagging in from legal/tax — 4 months in TW usually doesn't create a corporate permanent establishment, but local payroll and payroll tax registration may be required if the employee is performing work there for an extended period. we need to know if you will have any field/customer meetings in taiwan or be hiring/contracting locally. if yes, that ups the risk.
Maya Chen: no local hiring and all meetings are remote. might do 1 onsite meetup with a partner (single day) — does that change anything?
Kyle (Legal): a one-off partner meetup unlikely to change nexus, but please log partner details in the ticket. we'll still need to confirm payroll withholding and any social security totalization implications.
Adrian Lopez: about equipment: ops can ship, but customs paperwork required for >$800 USD shipments. ops will share the customs invoice template. do you want the standing desk shipped or reimbursed?
Maya Chen: prefer shipping if possible. standing desk is company property so should be covered.
People Ops: noted. operations teammate will DM for dimensions and courier preferences. Maya, expect an email from shipping@redwood.com within 48 hours.
Maya Chen: appreciated — thanks everyone. will await ticket updates. :wave:
Payroll Bot: ticket update RLOC-2024-183: Payroll next action: verify tax withholding rules and homebase status. ETA 3 business days.
